message.reasoning_content:
We need to solve: 9 children allergic to milk, 6 allergic to peanuts, 3 allergic to both. Total children 32. Find number with no allergies.

Let A = milk allergy, B = peanut allergy. |A|=9, |B|=6, |A∩B|=3. Then |A∪B| = |A|+|B|-|A∩B| = 9+6-3 = 12. So 12 children have at least one allergy. Total 32, so 32-12 = 20 children have no allergy.
